title: Spring 2027 undergraduate application schedule
body: This schedule applies to international undergraduate admission at Hanyang University Seoul for Spring 2027. All times are Korea Standard Time (KST). Online applications: September 1, 2026 at 10:00 through September 18, 2026 at 17:00. Documents: September 1 at 10:00 through September 30, 2026 at 17:00; documents must arrive by the deadline and are accepted by post only. Results are scheduled for December 18, 2026 on the OIA website. Tuition payment is tentatively January 2027. The semester begins March 2, 2027. Dates may change; check OIA notices. As of this archive's November 12, 2026 collection date, the application and document deadlines have passed.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate freshman eligibility
body: International freshman applicants must hold foreign nationality and have two foreign-national parents. The applicant and both parents must have held foreign nationality before the applicant entered high school. Where Korean nationality was held, it must have been renounced before high school entry; holders of dual nationality including Korean citizenship are ineligible. Applicants must have graduated or expect to graduate from high school. Expected graduates must submit their final graduation certificate before the semester begins. Family-status changes and exceptional nationality situations require supporting documents; consult the complete guide and admissions team.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate transfer eligibility
body: International transfer applicants have the same foreign-nationality requirements as freshman applicants: applicant and both parents must hold foreign nationality before high school entry, with no retained Korean dual nationality. Applicants at a four-year university (including three- or five-year bachelor's programs) must complete or expect to complete at least two years/four semesters, excluding summer and winter sessions. Junior-college applicants must graduate or expect to graduate with a vocational degree. The proposed Hanyang major must be similar to the previous university major. Final academic documents are required before the semester begins. This is an eligibility summary; page 10 of the official guide contains additional nationality and academic-background restrictions.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate admission contacts and postal submission
body: International undergraduate admission inquiries: adminugrd@hanyang.ac.kr; telephone +82-2-2220-2445 through 2448; website https://oia.hanyang.ac.kr/. Postal address: Office of International Affairs, Room 218, International Building, Hanyang University, 222 Wangsimni-ro, Seongdong-gu, Seoul 04763, Republic of Korea. The application schedule requires documents by post; in-person submission is not accepted.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate screening methods
body: International Studies (English track) and Data Science (English track) use document screening plus an English interview. Interior Architecture Design; Voice, Composition, Piano, Orchestral Instruments and Korean Traditional Music; Dance; and Theater and Film (Film major) use document screening plus artwork review. Theater and Film (Play Directing and Staff, Acting) also require an interview. Other programs use document screening alone. Artwork requirements vary by major: consult the full official guide rather than assuming one portfolio format applies to every department.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate dual applications and application fees
body: Seoul and ERICA admissions are managed separately. Seoul applicants may submit one choice or two choices. Business Administration (Korean or English track) and Media Communication can only be first choices. A single/first-choice application costs KRW 142,000; the second choice costs KRW 27,000, making the dual-application total KRW 169,000. Dual applicants must apply online twice and pay the first-choice fee before creating the second application. Academic and nationality documents need only one copy, but each major's other required documents and artwork must be supplied. Applicants rejected for their first choice are considered for their second choice. If accepted by both campuses, students may register at only one.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate Hanyang International Scholarship Program HISP
body: For newly admitted international undergraduates, HISP awards are based on overall scholastic achievement assessed during document or artwork evaluation. Award levels reduce tuition by 100%, 70%, or 50%. For freshmen, the listed support period is eight semesters, with a minimum 2.5 GPA each semester to retain the award. Recipient numbers vary each semester. Selection occurs during admission without a separate application. These awards cannot be combined with other on-campus scholarships; submit supporting documents during the official document-submission period.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate English proficiency scholarship
body: The Hanyang Scholarship for Excellence in English Language Proficiency awards a 30% tuition reduction for the first semester only to applicants with TOEFL iBT 90 or higher or IELTS 6.5 or higher. English-track applicants seeking this scholarship must submit their English certificate. Selection occurs during admission without a separate application; scholarship evidence must be submitted during the official document-submission period. This award cannot be combined with other on-campus scholarships. This scholarship threshold is distinct from a department's admission-language requirement.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate TOPIK scholarship
body: For newly admitted international undergraduates, TOPIK/TOPIK IBT level 6 holders receive a 100% tuition reduction, and level 5 holders receive a 50% reduction, for the first semester only. Applicants who graduated or expect to graduate from a high school in Korea are ineligible for the TOPIK level 5 scholarship. Selection is during admission without a separate application; certificates must be submitted during the official document-submission period. The award cannot be combined with other on-campus scholarships.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate Hanyang IIE scholarship
body: The Hanyang Institute of International Education scholarship is for applicants who completed the Korean language program at Hanyang IIE. Completion of IIE level 6 gives a 100% tuition reduction; completion of level 5 gives a 50% reduction. The award lasts for the first semester only. Selection is during admission without a separate application; submit evidence during the official document-submission period. The scholarship cannot be combined with other on-campus scholarships.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate alumni family scholarship
body: International undergraduate freshmen who are children of Hanyang undergraduate or graduate alumni may receive a 30% tuition reduction. The listed freshman period is eight semesters, requiring a minimum 2.5 GPA each semester to retain support. Submit the alumnus parent's graduation certificate with its document number for verification during the official document-submission period. The award cannot be combined with other on-campus scholarships.

title: Scholarships for enrolled international undergraduates in the Spring 2027 guide
body: The Spring 2027 admission guide lists Hanyang International Excellence Awards (HIEA) for enrolled international undergraduates with a previous-semester GPA of at least 3.0, and a TOPIK scholarship for students who obtain TOPIK level 5 or 6. The guide does not state the award amounts here. Enrolled-student scholarship regulations can change; check current OIA notices after admission for complete eligibility, award amounts, and application dates.

title: Undergraduate tuition table quoted in Spring 2027 guide: Fall 2026 rates
body: The Spring 2027 admission guide explicitly bases this tuition table on Fall 2026; these amounts are per semester in KRW and are subject to change. They are reference rates, not confirmed Spring 2027 charges. Humanities/Social Science: 5,279,000 (Humanities, Social Science, Economics and Finance, Business, International Studies, Policy Science). Natural Science/Sports: 6,150,000 (Natural Sciences, Human Ecology, Sports Management and Sports Science). Engineering: 6,960,000. Entertainment: 6,976,000 (Film and Theater, Dance). Music: 7,820,000. Consult the actual tuition notice for the amount due.

title: Spring 2027 undergraduate guide language and interpretation
body: The admission guideline was originally written in Korean and translated into other languages. The guide states that the Korean guideline prevails when interpretations conflict. Read the complete source for department-specific requirements and consult OIA for unresolved cases. This prepared collection covers selected checked topics and is not a replacement for all 23 PDF pages.
